name: Fire arrow
description: Pitch-bound and meant to burn. Do keep it away from the thatch you intend to sleep under.
notes: A special arrow (the fire arrow profile, mw-e05.1/e05.8). Special arrow band 3-8 per arrow (economy doc). Authored for shop stock (mw-ju8.3); not for sale until a shop row stocks it (mw-ju8.5).
